title: DC fusion center FOIA on psychotronic effects

tellings.quote: there was a FOIA leak out of the Washington D.C. fusion center that someone had filed a FOIA with regards to looking into some uh political groups, but it turned out that they were given I think the file was called uh effects on the human body.

plain: Someone who asked the Washington, D.C. fusion center, a hub where federal and local agencies share intelligence, for its records on certain political groups is said to have received instead a file titled "effects on the human body", about psychotronic effects, meaning devices said to act on the body or mind from a distance. A guest named Dave Rossi tells Michels this as a leak from a request under FOIA, a US law that lets anyone request government records, without naming who filed it, and the point would be that the government studies such effects.
